## Summary

Describe the proposed catalogue, documentation, or tooling change.

## Rationale and evidence

For data changes, identify the affected catalogue IDs and provide public evidence. Explain any category or scope decision.

## Checks

- [ ] I did not renumber or reuse a catalogue ID.
- [ ] I edited canonical inputs rather than generated exports.
- [ ] I ran `make build`.
- [ ] I ran `make validate`.
- [ ] Generated files are included and consistent with their inputs.
- [ ] I disclosed any relevant conflict of interest.
